$comment: Mission ids as used by Halo: Campaign Evolved in its gameplay tags. Verified against a 100% save: the 13 ids below are exactly the set that appears under Blam.Progress.Mission.Completion.*
openQuestions: The three bonus missions are Boarding Action, The Most Dangerous Game and Heavy Burden, but the mapping to e10/e20/e30 is not confirmed. Insertion point names hint at e30 = Boarding Action (ins_e30_space_1, ins_e30_grav_lift, ins_e30_transit_station).
c45 appears under Completion.unlock_c45 and in insertion points, but never under a difficulty completion tag. Probably a sub-section rather than a standalone mission.
Terminals use terminal_a10 while mission completion uses a15 for the same first mission.
